clean.about: Healthy link, 4 ms round trip: listen, a 5 s answer, listen, mic off.

talk-rtt60.about: 60 ms round trip through one answer. f4f5e76: microphone buffer overflows during the answer and the call ends.

talk-rtt160.about: 160 ms round trip through one answer.

listen-rtt160.about: 160 ms round trip, microphone only: no reply traffic and no lock contention.

loss-0.5pct.about: 10 ms round trip with 0.5% packet loss each way after any radio retries.

blackout-600ms.about: A 0.6 s total blackout while listening. lwIP's second retransmission comes about 3 s later, beyond the 1 s send limit: the call is replaced.

blackout-2500ms.about: A 2.5 s total blackout during an answer.
